title: Norwegian Cheesy Potato Gratin
description: A comforting, creamy side dish from Norway featuring thinly sliced potatoes, rich cheese, and a hint of nutmeg.
instructions: In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, create a layer of potatoes.
In a separate bowl, combine grated cheese, chicken broth, and softened butter.
Pour the cheese mixture over the potatoes, then sprinkle with nutmeg.
If using flour, sprinkle a pinch over the top.
Repeat the layering process, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
Let the gratin rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
